purpose: Verify successful creation and saving of an expense/voucher request as Draft (MSS)
preconditions: User is authenticated and authorized to create financial requests.
action_or_input: User selects Create Expense/Voucher Request, enters available request details, attaches supporting documents as needed, and selects save.
expected_result: System creates/updates the request in Draft state, records the action, and keeps the request editable by its creator.

purpose: Verify saving an incomplete expense/voucher request as Draft (Alternative Flow)
preconditions: User is authenticated and authorized to create financial requests.
action_or_input: User enters partial request details with missing submission-mandatory information and selects save.
expected_result: System identifies missing submission-mandatory information but still permits saving the request in Draft state.

purpose: Verify denial of expense/voucher request creation when user lacks authorization (Exception Flow)
preconditions: User is not authorized to create financial requests.
action_or_input: User attempts to select Create Expense/Voucher Request.
expected_result: Request creation is denied; no new request is created.

purpose: Verify successful submission of a complete Draft expense/voucher request for Finance validation (MSS)
preconditions: Request exists in Draft state with all submission-mandatory information complete.
action_or_input: Creator selects Submit Request.
expected_result: System validates submission completeness, sets status to Submitted, locks ordinary creator editing, routes the request to Finance Staff, records the transition, and creates relevant submission notification(s).

purpose: Verify submission validation failure for an incomplete Draft expense/voucher request (Alternative Flow)
preconditions: Request exists in Draft state with missing or invalid submission information.
action_or_input: Creator selects Submit Request.
expected_result: System validation fails, shows missing/invalid information, and request remains in Draft state.

purpose: Verify handling of routing failure during expense/voucher request submission (Exception Flow)
preconditions: Request exists in Draft state and submission validation succeeds, but routing failure occurs.
action_or_input: Creator selects Submit Request.
expected_result: Request remains in Submitted state but is flagged for administrative recovery without losing history.

purpose: Verify successful Finance review and validation passing all financial, policy, and departmental budget checks (MSS)
preconditions: Request is in Submitted or Query Responded state, and Finance Staff is authorized for the request.
action_or_input: Finance Staff reviews request details and documents, performs applicable financial and policy checks, performs departmental budget check, and confirms validation when all checks pass.
expected_result: System sets status to Finance Validated and routes the request to the configured approval route.

purpose: Verify raising a Finance clarification query during request review (Alternative Flow)
preconditions: Request is in Submitted or Query Responded state, and Finance Staff identifies clarification is needed.
action_or_input: Finance Staff records a clarification query on the request.
expected_result: System sets status to Query Raised and notifies the request creator.

purpose: Verify handling when material anomaly is detected during Finance review (Alternative Flow)
preconditions: Request is in Submitted or Query Responded state, and Finance Staff identifies a material anomaly.
action_or_input: Finance Staff records/initiates anomaly handling for the detected issue.
expected_result: System initiates anomaly handling and ensures the request does not become Finance Validated.

purpose: Verify handling when required departmental budget reference is unavailable (Exception Flow)
preconditions: Request is in Submitted or Query Responded state, and required departmental budget reference is unavailable.
action_or_input: Finance Staff attempts to complete Finance validation.
expected_result: Finance validation cannot complete; the issue is recorded for recovery/clarification, and no false validation is recorded.

purpose: Verify successful response submission to a Finance clarification query (MSS)
preconditions: A Finance query is open for a record owned/represented by the user.
action_or_input: User reviews the query, enters response information, attaches requested evidence, and submits the response.
expected_result: System records the response, sets query status to Query Responded, and notifies Finance Staff.

purpose: Verify prevention of response submission when required response information is incomplete (Alternative Flow)
preconditions: A Finance query is open for a record owned/represented by the user.
action_or_input: User enters incomplete response information omitting required fields/evidence and attempts to submit.
expected_result: System prevents response submission, identifies missing required response information, and query remains open with prior history preserved.

purpose: Verify access denial when user lacks ownership or representation authority for the query (Exception Flow)
preconditions: User lacks ownership or representation authority for the record with the open Finance query.
action_or_input: User attempts to access or submit a response to the Finance clarification query.
expected_result: Access is denied; no response is recorded.

purpose: Verify successful internal Finance processing and recording of an approved expense/voucher request (MSS)
preconditions: Request status is Approved, and internal processing information is complete.
action_or_input: Finance Staff confirms completion of internal processing.
expected_result: System records processing details, user, and timestamp, sets terminal internal record state to Recorded, makes the request read-only, and creates relevant status notification(s).

purpose: Verify prevention of completion when internal processing record is incomplete (Alternative Flow)
preconditions: Request status is Approved, and required processing record details are incomplete.
action_or_input: Finance Staff attempts to confirm completion of internal processing.
expected_result: System prevents completion, retains Approved state, and no false record-completion state is stored.

purpose: Verify no real payment or bank-transfer operation is invoked during recording (Exception Flow)
preconditions: Request status is Approved.
action_or_input: Finance Staff confirms internal processing recording.
expected_result: System records internal completion and sets state to Recorded without invoking real payment or bank-transfer operations.

purpose: Verify authority approval routing to next authority when further approval level is required (MSS)
preconditions: Request is Finance Validated or Approval Pending, actor is configured current approver eligible under segregation of duties, and another approval level is required.
action_or_input: Authority reviews request, Finance validation, and prior approval history, selects Approve, and records remarks.
expected_result: System records the decision, routes to the next eligible authority, status becomes/remains Approval Pending, and relevant actors are notified.

purpose: Verify authority approval reaching final Approved status when no further level is required (MSS)
preconditions: Request is Finance Validated or Approval Pending, actor is configured current approver eligible under segregation of duties, and no further approval level is required.
action_or_input: Authority reviews request and prior history, selects Approve, and records remarks.
expected_result: System records decision, sets request status to Approved, and notifies relevant actors.

purpose: Verify authority rejection of an expense/voucher request (Alternative Flow)
preconditions: Request is Finance Validated or Approval Pending, and actor is the configured current approver.
action_or_input: Authority selects Reject and records remarks.
expected_result: System records the decision, sets request status to Rejected, and notifies relevant actors.

purpose: Verify blocking of approval decision upon self-approval detection (Alternative Flow)
preconditions: Request is Finance Validated or Approval Pending, and current approver is detected as the request creator/beneficiary (self-approval).
action_or_input: Actor attempts to approve the request.
expected_result: System blocks the self-approval decision and routes the request to the next eligible configured authority under segregation of duties.

purpose: Verify handling of approval action timeout (Exception Flow)
preconditions: Request is Finance Validated or Approval Pending, assigned to an authority, and action time limit expires.
action_or_input: Approval action times out without an authority decision.
expected_result: System initiates overdue approval escalation under IAA-BR-401 / IAA-UC-202.

purpose: Verify authority approval of an escalated approval item routing to next level (MSS)
preconditions: Expense/voucher request or high-value TA claim is in Escalated state/context, assigned to actor under configured route, and another configured approval level remains.
action_or_input: Authority reviews item, Finance verification/validation, escalation reason, and approval history, selects Approve, and records remarks.
expected_result: System records decision, routes to next eligible authority, status becomes Approval Pending, audit-logs action, and notifies relevant actors.

purpose: Verify final authority approval of an escalated approval item when no further level remains (MSS)
preconditions: Expense/voucher request or high-value TA claim is in Escalated state/context, assigned to actor under configured route, and no further approval level remains.
action_or_input: Authority selects Approve and records remarks.
expected_result: System records decision, sets status to Approved, audit-logs action, and notifies relevant actors.

purpose: Verify authority rejection of an escalated approval item (Alternative Flow)
preconditions: Expense/voucher request or high-value TA claim is in Escalated state/context, assigned to actor under configured route.
action_or_input: Authority selects Reject and records remarks.
expected_result: System records decision, sets status to Rejected, audit-logs action, and notifies relevant actors.

purpose: Verify blocking and rerouting when self-approval or ineligibility is detected on escalated item (Alternative Flow)
preconditions: Expense/voucher request or high-value TA claim is in Escalated state/context, and actor is detected as ineligible/self-approver.
action_or_input: Ineligible actor attempts to decide the escalated item.
expected_result: System blocks the decision and routes to the next eligible configured authority.

purpose: Verify exception handling when no eligible configured authority can be resolved for escalated item (Exception Flow)
preconditions: Expense/voucher request or high-value TA claim is in Escalated state/context, and no eligible configured authority can be resolved.
action_or_input: System evaluates routing for the escalated item.
expected_result: System preserves the Escalated item, records a routing exception for administrative recovery, and does not apply an unauthorized decision.

purpose: Verify automatic escalation of overdue approval to the next eligible authority (MSS)
preconditions: Expense/voucher request is Finance Validated or Approval Pending (or high-value TA claim is Approval Pending), assignment and timestamp exist, timeout expires, and no valid decision has completed approval.
action_or_input: Timeout event is evaluated against active approval assignment and configured limit.
expected_result: System confirms approval is still pending, determines next eligible authority under configured route and segregation-of-duties rules, sets approval item to Escalated, routes it to that authority, records escalation, and notifies relevant actors.

purpose: Verify skipping of ineligible candidate authority during automatic escalation (Alternative Flow)
preconditions: Approval item is overdue for escalation, and the immediate candidate authority is ineligible under segregation-of-duties rules.
action_or_input: System evaluates overdue approval and identifies the next candidate authority.
expected_result: System skips the ineligible candidate and selects/routes to the next eligible configured authority.

purpose: Verify exception handling when no eligible configured authority is available during escalation (Exception Flow)
preconditions: Approval item is overdue for escalation, and no eligible configured authority is available in the route.
action_or_input: System attempts to route the overdue approval item.
expected_result: System preserves the Escalated item, records a routing exception for administrative recovery, does not auto-approve or auto-reject, and preserves prior decision history intact.

purpose: Verify authorized actor successfully flags a traceable anomaly in Open state (MSS)
preconditions: Relevant financial record/process exists and actor is authorized to flag anomalies.
action_or_input: Actor identifies/selects affected record, enters anomaly category, description, and available evidence/remarks, and submits.
expected_result: System creates/links an anomaly record in Open state, routes anomaly to configured designated resolver, and notifies relevant recipients.

purpose: Verify non-material validation errors do not create an anomaly (Exception Flow)
preconditions: Financial record exhibits ordinary completeness or validation error that is not configured as a material anomaly.
action_or_input: System/actor performs routine validation check.
expected_result: Ordinary error is handled in its normal validation path and does not create an anomaly record; source record remains intact.

purpose: Verify designated resolver successfully resolves an anomaly (MSS)
preconditions: Anomaly is in Open or Escalated state, and actor is the configured resolver for its category.
action_or_input: Resolver reviews anomaly details, evidence, and related record history, records resolution evidence/remarks, and submits resolution.
expected_result: System sets anomaly state to Resolved and records the resolution action with traceable history.

purpose: Verify designated resolver escalates an anomaly to the next resolver (Alternative Flow)
preconditions: Anomaly is in Open or Escalated state, actor is designated resolver, and further escalation is required.
action_or_input: Resolver records escalation reason and submits.
expected_result: System sets anomaly state to Escalated and routes anomaly to the next designated resolver.

purpose: Verify action denial when actor is not the designated resolver for anomaly category (Exception Flow)
preconditions: Anomaly is in Open or Escalated state, and actor is not the configured designated resolver for its category.
action_or_input: Actor attempts to resolve or escalate the anomaly.
expected_result: Action is denied; existing anomaly state and history remain unchanged.

purpose: Verify automatic anomaly creation and routing upon detection of material condition (MSS)
preconditions: Relevant IAA financial record/process exists, and a detected condition is configured as a material anomaly condition.
action_or_input: System detects condition and validates that it is configured as material.
expected_result: System creates and links an anomaly record in Open state to affected record/process, records category/context, routes anomaly to configured designated resolver, audit-logs event, and notifies relevant recipients.

purpose: Verify no anomaly is created when detected condition is not configured as material (Alternative Flow)
preconditions: Relevant IAA financial record/process exists, and detected condition is not configured as material.
action_or_input: System evaluates detected validation/process condition.
expected_result: No anomaly record is created; underlying validation outcome remains in its normal path.

purpose: Verify handling when automatic anomaly creation or routing cannot complete (Exception Flow)
preconditions: Configured material anomaly condition occurs, but anomaly creation or routing fails to complete.
action_or_input: System attempts to create and route automatic anomaly.
expected_result: System preserves source record, records a recoverable processing exception without inventing a resolution outcome, and records no unsupported anomaly or false state.

purpose: Verify successful submission of a complete employee TA claim (MSS)
preconditions: User is authenticated and eligible to submit TA claims.
action_or_input: User enters trip dates, purpose, claimed amount, required details, attaches supporting documents, and submits the claim.
expected_result: System validates submission completeness, creates TA record, sets status to Submitted, locks ordinary edits, and notifies Finance Staff.

purpose: Verify validation error and submission prevention when mandatory TA information is missing (Alternative Flow)
preconditions: User is authenticated and eligible to submit TA claims.
action_or_input: User omits mandatory TA information/documents and attempts to submit claim.
expected_result: System displays validation errors, does not submit the claim, and no invalid TA submission is created.

purpose: Verify submission denial when user is ineligible to submit TA claims (Exception Flow)
preconditions: User is not eligible to submit TA claims.
action_or_input: User attempts to submit a TA claim.
expected_result: Submission is denied; no TA submission is created.

purpose: Verify successful TA form verification setting status to Verified when no authority approval is required (MSS)
preconditions: TA claim is in Submitted or Query Responded state, policy requirements and budget pass, and no authority approval is required.
action_or_input: Finance Staff reviews claim details and supporting documents, verifies policy compliance, checks departmental budget, and confirms verification.
expected_result: System sets TA claim status to Verified and readies it for internal processing.

purpose: Verify TA form verification routing to Approval Pending when high-value approval is required (MSS)
preconditions: TA claim is in Submitted or Query Responded state, meets high-value threshold requiring authority approval, and policy and budget checks pass.
action_or_input: Finance Staff verifies policy compliance, checks departmental budget, and confirms verification.
expected_result: System sets TA claim status to Approval Pending and routes the claim for high-value authority approval.

purpose: Verify Finance Staff raising clarification query on submitted TA claim (Alternative Flow)
preconditions: TA claim is in Submitted or Query Responded state, and Finance Staff identifies clarification is needed.
action_or_input: Finance Staff raises a query on the TA claim.
expected_result: System sets TA claim status to Query Raised and notifies the claim submitter.

purpose: Verify TA claim rejection with remarks when policy verification fails (Alternative Flow)
preconditions: TA claim is in Submitted or Query Responded state, and fails configured TA policy requirements.
action_or_input: Finance Staff rejects the claim with recorded remarks.
expected_result: System sets TA claim status to Rejected with recorded remarks.

purpose: Verify initiation of anomaly handling for material budget/policy issue during TA verification (Alternative Flow)
preconditions: TA claim is in Submitted or Query Responded state, and a material budget/policy issue is identified.
action_or_input: Finance Staff initiates anomaly handling for the material issue.
expected_result: System initiates anomaly handling rather than silently rejecting solely for budget insufficiency; no false verification is recorded.

purpose: Verify TA verification handling when required policy or budget configuration is unavailable (Exception Flow)
preconditions: TA claim is in Submitted or Query Responded state, and required policy or budget configuration is unavailable.
action_or_input: Finance Staff attempts to perform verification.
expected_result: Verification cannot complete; the issue is recorded, and no false verification is recorded.

purpose: Verify authority approval of high-value TA claim routing to next level when required (MSS)
preconditions: TA claim is in Approval Pending state, actor is eligible current approver, and another approval level is required.
action_or_input: Authority reviews claim, Finance verification, and prior history, selects Approve, and records remarks.
expected_result: System records decision, routes claim onward, and claim remains in Approval Pending state.

purpose: Verify authority approval of high-value TA claim reaching final Approved status (MSS)
preconditions: TA claim is in Approval Pending state, actor is eligible current approver, and no further approval level is required.
action_or_input: Authority reviews claim and prior history, selects Approve, and records remarks.
expected_result: System records decision and sets TA claim status to Approved.

purpose: Verify authority rejection of high-value TA claim with remarks (Alternative Flow)
preconditions: TA claim is in Approval Pending state, and actor is eligible current approver.
action_or_input: Authority selects Reject and records remarks.
expected_result: System records decision and sets TA claim status to Rejected.

purpose: Verify blocking and rerouting upon self-approval detection on high-value TA claim (Alternative Flow)
preconditions: TA claim is in Approval Pending state, and current approver is detected as the claim submitter/beneficiary.
action_or_input: Actor attempts to approve the TA claim.
expected_result: System blocks the decision and routes the claim to the next eligible configured authority.

purpose: Verify handling when pending high-value TA approval times out (Exception Flow)
preconditions: TA claim is in Approval Pending state assigned to an authority, and action time limit expires.
action_or_input: Approval action times out without an authority decision.
expected_result: System initiates overdue approval escalation under IAA-BR-401.

purpose: Verify successful internal processing and recording of verified or approved TA claim (MSS)
preconditions: TA claim is in Verified status (with no further authority approval required) or Approved status, and processing information is complete.
action_or_input: Finance Staff confirms completion of internal processing.
expected_result: System records processing details and timestamp, sets terminal internal state to Recorded, makes TA record read-only, and notifies relevant actors.

purpose: Verify prevention of TA processing completion when required processing information is missing (Alternative Flow)
preconditions: TA claim is in Verified or Approved status, and required processing information is missing.
action_or_input: Finance Staff attempts to confirm processing completion.
expected_result: System prevents completion, retains prior valid state, and no false completion is recorded.

purpose: Verify no real payment or bank-transfer operation occurs during TA recording (Exception Flow)
preconditions: TA claim is in Verified or Approved status.
action_or_input: Finance Staff records processing completion.
expected_result: System records internal completion and sets state to Recorded without executing real payment or bank-transfer operations.

purpose: Verify authorized auditor successfully raises an audit observation in Open state (MSS)
preconditions: Auditor is authorized and target financial record/process exists.
action_or_input: Auditor selects target, enters observation details, and submits.
expected_result: System creates observation in Open state, links it to target record/process, and notifies concerned user/department.

purpose: Verify prevention of observation creation when mandatory observation information is missing (Alternative Flow)
preconditions: Auditor is authorized and target financial record/process exists.
action_or_input: Auditor omits mandatory observation information and attempts to create observation.
expected_result: System prevents creation, identifies validation errors, and no incomplete observation is created.

purpose: Verify denial of audit observation creation when target is outside auditor scope (Exception Flow)
preconditions: Target record/process is not accessible under auditor authorized scope.
action_or_input: Auditor attempts to raise an observation against the target.
expected_result: Creation is denied; no observation is created.

purpose: Verify authorized user successfully submits response and evidence to an Open audit observation (MSS)
preconditions: Observation is in Open state, and user is authorized to respond.
action_or_input: User reviews observation, records corrective action/response, attaches required supporting evidence, and submits response.
expected_result: System sets observation status to Responded, preserves response and evidence history, and notifies Auditor.

purpose: Verify prevention of response submission when response or evidence is incomplete (Alternative Flow)
preconditions: Observation is in Open state, and user is authorized to respond.
action_or_input: User enters incomplete response or omits required evidence and attempts to submit.
expected_result: System prevents submission, observation remains Open, and prior information is preserved.

purpose: Verify denial of audit observation response when user is unauthorized (Exception Flow)
preconditions: Observation is in Open state, and user is not authorized to respond.
action_or_input: User attempts to submit a response to the observation.
expected_result: Response action is denied; observation remains Open with prior history preserved.

purpose: Verify auditor closes an audit observation upon satisfactory verification of corrective action (MSS)
preconditions: Observation is in Responded state, and auditor verifies corrective action and evidence as satisfactory.
action_or_input: Auditor selects Close.
expected_result: System sets observation status to Closed, records closure details, and makes the closed record read-only.

purpose: Verify auditor returns observation to Open when response is unsatisfactory (Alternative Flow)
preconditions: Observation is in Responded state, and auditor determines response/corrective action is unsatisfactory.
action_or_input: Auditor records reasons for dissatisfaction and returns the observation.
expected_result: System sets observation status back to Open and notifies concerned user for another response cycle.

purpose: Verify blocking of observation closure when attempted without required verification (Exception Flow)
preconditions: Observation is in Responded state, but required verification has not been performed.
action_or_input: Auditor attempts to select Close without performing required verification.
expected_result: System blocks closure, and observation remains in Responded state.

purpose: Verify auditor successfully reviews authorized in-process or completed financial records (MSS)
preconditions: Auditor is authenticated and authorized for the record scope.
action_or_input: Auditor selects an authorized record from presented records.
expected_result: System displays record details, approvals, anomalies, status history, and audit trail in read-only form without modifying operational state.

purpose: Verify informational result when no financial records match auditor filter (Alternative Flow)
preconditions: Auditor is authenticated and authorized for the record scope.
action_or_input: Auditor applies search/filter criteria for which no records match.
expected_result: System displays an informational result indicating no records match filter; no operational data is modified.

purpose: Verify access denial when auditor attempts to access record outside authorized scope (Exception Flow)
preconditions: Auditor is authenticated, but target record is outside auditor authorized scope.
action_or_input: Auditor attempts to access the record.
expected_result: Access is denied; no record details are displayed or modified.

purpose: Verify authorized user views permitted read-only IAA reports and dashboards (MSS)
preconditions: User is authenticated and active role has reporting access.
action_or_input: User selects a report/dashboard view permitted to active role and applies optional filters.
expected_result: System displays request status summaries, approval turnaround information, anomalies, and audit observations within authorized scope without operational state change.

purpose: Verify informational message when no data is available for selected report/dashboard view (Alternative Flow)
preconditions: User is authenticated and active role has reporting access.
action_or_input: User selects an authorized view/filter combination containing no matching data.
expected_result: System displays an informational message indicating no data for selection.

purpose: Verify access denial when user attempts to access report or scope unauthorized for active role (Exception Flow)
preconditions: User is authenticated, but selected report or scope is unauthorized for active role.
action_or_input: User attempts to view unauthorized report or scope.
expected_result: Access is denied; no unauthorized data is disclosed or modified.

purpose: Verify successful export of authorized read-only report in allowed configured format (MSS)
preconditions: User is viewing an authorized report.
action_or_input: User selects export in an allowed configured format.
expected_result: System generates an export in the allowed configured format and provides it to the user without altering source data.

purpose: Verify user notification when exporting a report with no data/export content (Alternative Flow)
preconditions: User is viewing an authorized report that contains no data/content.
action_or_input: User initiates report export.
expected_result: System informs the user that there is no data/export content, and no file is exported.

purpose: Verify error reporting without altering source data when export generation fails (Exception Flow)
preconditions: User is viewing an authorized report, but export generation encounters a system failure.
action_or_input: User initiates report export.
expected_result: System reports an error to the user without altering source data.

purpose: Verify user successfully views status and visible history of own requests and TA claims (MSS)
preconditions: User is authenticated.
action_or_input: User selects an owned/represented record from the displayed list.
expected_result: System displays current status and visible history in read-only form without changing record state.

purpose: Verify informational message when user has no matching own records (Alternative Flow)
preconditions: User is authenticated and has no owned or represented records.
action_or_input: User accesses the tracking view.
expected_result: System displays an informational message indicating no matching records found.

purpose: Verify access denial when attempting to track record outside permitted ownership or scope (Exception Flow)
preconditions: User is authenticated.
action_or_input: User attempts to view a record outside permitted ownership/representation scope.
expected_result: Access is denied; no record details or history are displayed.

purpose: Verify user views permitted notifications and pending actions with navigation to related record (MSS)
preconditions: User is authenticated and has an active role.
action_or_input: User opens a notification from the list of notifications permitted for active role/ownership/assignment.
expected_result: System displays event/pending-action context and provides navigation to related IAA record where permitted without changing operational state.

purpose: Verify empty/informational state displayed when user has no notifications (Alternative Flow)
preconditions: User is authenticated and has an active role, with no notifications present.
action_or_input: User accesses notifications view.
expected_result: System displays an empty/informational state.

purpose: Verify non-disclosure of linked operational data when notification target is no longer authorized (Exception Flow)
preconditions: User is authenticated, but authorization for notification target record has lapsed/revoked.
action_or_input: User attempts to access linked operational data via the notification.
expected_result: Linked operational data is not disclosed; access to unauthorized record is denied.

purpose: Verify user successfully switches active IAA role among assigned roles (MSS)
preconditions: User is authenticated and has at least two assigned IAA roles.
action_or_input: User selects an assigned role from displayed list to switch.
expected_result: System activates selected role for IAA authorization context, records role-switch event, and subsequent actions execute under that role context.

purpose: Verify activation denial and retention of current role when selected role is no longer assigned (Alternative Flow)
preconditions: User is authenticated, but selected role is no longer assigned to user.
action_or_input: User attempts to switch to the unassigned role.
expected_result: Activation is denied, and user current active role remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify re-authentication requirement when session is invalid during role switch (Exception Flow)
preconditions: User session is invalid or expired.
action_or_input: User attempts to switch active IAA role.
expected_result: Role switch is blocked, and re-authentication is required.

purpose: Verify Admin manages IAA role assignments without exposing operational financial content (MSS)
preconditions: Admin is authenticated with IAA configuration privilege.
action_or_input: Admin selects a user, views current IAA role assignments displayed without operational financial content, adds or removes roles, and saves.
expected_result: System validates and saves configuration, logs the change, updates role assignments, and preserves historical action records intact.

purpose: Verify rejection of invalid role/user combination change (Alternative Flow)
preconditions: Admin is authenticated with IAA configuration privilege.
action_or_input: Admin attempts to assign an invalid role/user combination.
expected_result: System rejects the change, and existing role assignment configuration remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify denial of access to operational financial data during role administration (Exception Flow)
preconditions: Admin is performing IAA role administration.
action_or_input: Admin attempts to access operational financial request content/data.
expected_result: Access to operational financial data is denied; only role configuration functions are accessible.

purpose: Verify Admin successfully configures approval hierarchy levels, thresholds, and routing parameters (MSS)
preconditions: Admin is authenticated with IAA configuration privilege.
action_or_input: Admin defines/updates hierarchy levels, authority roles, amount criteria, request-type/department routing criteria, and timeout parameters, and saves.
expected_result: System validates configuration consistency, saves configuration, audit-logs the change, and makes valid approval-routing configuration active for subsequent routing.

purpose: Verify blocking of activation and identification of errors for invalid or incomplete hierarchy configuration (Alternative Flow)
preconditions: Admin is authenticated with IAA configuration privilege.
action_or_input: Admin enters an invalid or incomplete hierarchy configuration and attempts to activate/save.
expected_result: System blocks activation, identifies configuration errors, and prior valid configuration remains active.

purpose: Verify configuration privilege does not grant Admin operational approval rights (Exception Flow)
preconditions: Admin has IAA configuration privilege but lacks operational approval rights.
action_or_input: Admin attempts to perform an operational approval on an expense/voucher or TA request.
expected_result: Operational approval action is denied; approval configuration privilege does not grant operational approval rights.

purpose: Verify Admin successfully configures financial year and policy parameters (MSS)
preconditions: Admin is authenticated with IAA configuration privilege.
action_or_input: Admin creates/updates financial-year and supported policy parameters and saves.
expected_result: System validates values and effective periods, saves configuration, logs the change, and stores valid configuration for subsequent IAA processing.

purpose: Verify blocking of activation for invalid or overlapping financial year or policy configuration (Alternative Flow)
preconditions: Admin is authenticated with IAA configuration privilege.
action_or_input: Admin enters invalid or overlapping financial-year/policy parameters and attempts to save.
expected_result: System blocks activation, identifies errors, and prior valid configuration remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify operational financial request content is not exposed during policy and financial year configuration (Exception Flow)
preconditions: Admin is configuring IAA policy and financial year parameters.
action_or_input: Admin accesses policy/financial year configuration screens.
expected_result: Operational financial request content is not exposed to Admin; screen displays configuration parameters only.
